body:
Names herself and explains the practical skills of the people the adventurers are trying to help.

Recorded role and choices

Gretchen reacts urgently when Brooks is in danger and later answers Camilla’s questions about the group’s professions: ordinary trades such as farming, baking and woodworking. Her bitter statement that the gods do not care remains her expressed belief. The scene gives the rescued community a named voice without establishing a later political office or a complete family tree.
